children: Overview
Sweden electric car maker's Q2 revenue fell 8% yr/yr amid U.S. regulatory headwinds
Q2 net loss narrowed 55% yr/yr, helped by absence of prior-year impairment charges
Company cut 2026 volume growth guidance to low-to-mid single digits from low double digits
Outlook
Polestar updates 2026 volume guidance to low-to-mid single-digit growth from prior low double-digit growth
Company expects market environment to remain highly competitive and volatile in H2 2026
Further negative adjustments related to U.S. restructuring expected in future periods
Result Drivers
U.S. RESTRUCTURING - Co said regulatory changes and restructuring measures in the U.S. led to increased costs and negative adjustments to inventory and assets
LOWER CARBON CREDIT SALES - Co said reduced carbon credit sales, mainly in the EU and U.S., negatively impacted revenue
COST DISCIPLINE - Co said continued cost discipline and reduced headcount helped offset some expenses
